This repository was created for the course **From Data to Design: Using Big Data for Active Mobility Research** taught at the [2026 DTN Annual Forum](https://annualforum.ut.ee/) given by [Avital Angel](https://www.mos.ed.tum.de/en/sv/about-us/team/dr-avital-angel/) and [Gabriel Valença](https://ushift.tecnico.ulisboa.pt/team-gabriel-valenca/) in Tartu, Estonia on June 14th and 15th of 2026.
